resolvedFindings.finding: Spatial boards can make layout the only meaning carrier.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require typed textual edges and list, outline, table, and nonvisual parity.

resolvedFindings.finding: Clues can be mistaken for objective facts.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Separate clues, observations, claims, hypotheses, conclusions, and truth.

resolvedFindings.finding: Shared boards can leak private discoveries.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Use explicit per-record audiences and identical authorization filters for every derivative.

resolvedFindings.finding: Evidence can duplicate Asset, Character, Location, or Event authority.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Reference owning-domain records and use atomic adapters.

resolvedFindings.finding: Correction or undo can erase mystery history.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Use superseding, revocation, and compensating Events without deletion.

resolvedFindings.finding: Search, export, diagnostics, notifications, or AI can bypass visibility.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Apply one server-side projection contract to all surfaces.

resolvedFindings.finding: Pack update/removal can rewrite live investigation state.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Retain exact source snapshots and tombstones under entitlement policy.
